description:
We were born from a shared curiosity: to discover how far science, technology, and imagination can go. We are a Paraguayan duo of two people who share a passion for space exploration, innovation, and developing new ideas.

We have skills in programming, video game development, 3D design, creativity, and teamwork. Through our project NOVA EON, we aim to bring space exploration closer to new generations through interactive experiences that spark curiosity and foster an interest in science.

We believe that great ideas are built by sharing knowledge, experimenting, and facing new challenges. We are passionate and committed people, and in addition to having skills in space sciences, programming, 3D modeling, animation, design, and web development, we are looking above all for a challenge to test ourselves—and that is why we created NOVA EON.
